actions: probe installed Claude Code without invoking a model, verify its session-ID and session-plugin loading surfaces, strictly validate and exactly enumerate the bundled session plugin, and report only demonstrated capabilities with destination-local authentication state and typed availability
prepare a stable --session-id and --plugin-dir command with a sanitized environment that excludes credential-bearing variables and NODE_OPTIONS
open the production Claude adapter through the same Cockpit Project-focused Controller action used by conformance
launch the installed CLI in a runtime-owned PTY rooted at the selected Project and keep it alive across browser disconnection
load the minimal plugin and thin shim, inject only sanitized selected work-context facts, and carry exact prepare, approve or reject, and start operations over the typed provider channel
enforce one writable terminal attachment with read-only observers
classify unavailable CLI, missing or failed authentication, network, provider outage, quota, model-behavior uncertainty, and Sand-King adapter failure distinctly

on the final acceptance child only, have a person inspect the work context, explicitly approve the exact immutable Launch request in the Claude conversation, start it separately, and observe the conformance Harness outcome in the Cockpit

canonicalStateInvariants: conformance remains the deterministic merge oracle while Claude uses the same public Cockpit, Controller-runtime, work-context, preview, approval, and observation interfaces
the Controller runtime owns the PTY and provider lifecycle while the adapter owns only probe, command preparation, plugin shim forwarding, and typed provider reasons
the controller-assigned supported CLI session UUID is stable and retained independently from the Sand-King Controller-session identity
the bundled plugin is truthfully identified as session-loaded through --plugin-dir with a runtime-private typed CLI shim; no user-installed plugin record is claimed
only the owning focused Controller session can submit the exact request ID and expected revision
approval remains separate from Harness-run start and browser interaction cannot assert approval
browser disconnection detaches without terminating the Claude process
Project execution state remains Host-private and the selected Project receives no Sand-King state
the actual authenticated Claude interaction is performed by the final human/environment acceptance child, never fabricated by deterministic automation
